title_en: Required: Submission of the Graduate Thesis Research Course Registration Confirmation Form, Fall Semester (2nd Semester) 2026
summary: All graduate students registered for Graduate Thesis Research (430.960) in the 2nd semester of 2026 must complete an online Google Form and submit a signed confirmation form to Room 319 between 3 and 17 September 2026. Students who do not submit will receive a grade of U.
applies_to: All graduate students who have registered for Graduate Thesis Research (430.960). Integrated master's-doctoral (석박통합과정) students taking two sections of Thesis Research in one semester must obtain each professor's permission in advance and submit a separate confirmation form from each of the two professors.

dates.what: Submission period for the Google Form and the signed confirmation form
Date from which this departmental rule has been in effect

steps: Complete the Google Form first: https://forms.gle/o1sWaLY5wiaKxsKz7
Download the attached form, Graduate Thesis Research Course Registration Confirmation Form (대학원 논문연구 과목수강 확인서), from the notice.
Fill in the form within one page, including your research content, thesis title, and at least three references.

In the field for the professor in charge (담당교수), write the name of the professor whose Thesis Research section you registered for. If you registered with a professor other than your academic advisor, write both your advisor's name (지도교수명) and the name of the professor you registered with (신청교수님명) at the top of the form.

Obtain the professor's seal or signature on the form: normally your academic advisor's; if you registered with a different professor, obtain the signature of that professor (the professor in charge) at the bottom of the form.

If you are an integrated master's-doctoral student taking two Thesis Research sections this semester, obtain permission from the professors in advance and prepare a separate confirmation form signed by each of the two professors.
Submit the completed, signed form(s) to the staff member in charge in Room 319 by Thursday, 17 September 2026. Both the Google Form and the paper form are required for the submission to be complete.
translation:
Required: Submission of the Graduate Thesis Research Course Registration Confirmation Form, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year

★ Key Points
- Submission period: Thursday, 3 September 2026 to Thursday, 17 September 2026
- Who must submit: Submission is mandatory for all graduate students registered for Graduate Thesis Research (430.960). (If you do not submit, you will be given a grade of U.)
- How to submit: You must complete BOTH steps 1 and 2 below for your submission to be complete.
1) First, complete the Google Form: https://forms.gle/o1sWaLY5wiaKxsKz7
2) Fill in the attached confirmation form (including your academic advisor's seal) and submit it to the staff member in charge in Room 319.

★ Details
- Download the attachment and fill it in within one page, including your research content, thesis title, and references (at least three).
- For the professor in charge (담당교수), write the name of the professor whose Thesis Research section you registered for.
- Normally students register with their academic advisor, so the professor in charge is the same as the academic advisor. However, if for some reason you registered with a professor other than your academic advisor, write both your academic advisor's name and the name of the professor you registered with at the top of the form, and obtain the signature of the professor in charge (the professor you registered with) at the bottom of the form.
- Integrated master's-doctoral program (석박통합과정) students who take two sections of Thesis Research in the same semester must obtain the professors' permission in advance, and must obtain and submit a separate confirmation form from each of the two professors.

(Notes)
- Attachment: Graduate Thesis Research Course Registration Confirmation Form (대학원 논문연구 과목수강 확인서)
- The above is a departmental regulation and has been in effect since the 1st semester of 2016.
- Inquiries: Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person and email address are given in the original notice.

Attachment (1 file): 대학원논문연구 과목수강 확인서_v2.hwp (33 KB). The content of this attached file was not read; please download it from the original notice.
